## This section goes through using windowed PCA analysis using PCANGSD, then lostruct to identify outlier windows for each chromosome.

### 1) First, need to create windowed beagle files. These are generated by splitting each of the main chromosome beagle files into separate files of 1000 SNPs each.
To do this, run the 01_windowed_beagles.sh script.

### 2) Next, run PCANGSD on each windowed beagle file.
Run the 02_pcangsd_chroms_window.sh script.

### 3) Run lostruct on windowed covariance matrix files for each chromosome.
Run the 03a_lostruct_winpcangsd.R and 03b_lostruct_winpcangsd_job.sh scripts (note the code in these is adapted from X. Dallaire's script local_pca_maxdepth.R found at https://github.com/xav9536/angsd_pipeline/blob/master/01_scripts/Rscripts/local_pca_maxdepth.R)
